nvitk.gui.io.export¶

Export Napari layers to disk via nvitk.io writers.

Functions¶

layer_to_image(→ nvitk.types.Image)

Build an Image from a Napari layer (Image / Labels).

layer_to_mesh(→ nvitk.types.Mesh)

Build a Mesh from a Napari Surface layer.

write_mesh_stl(→ None)

Write a mesh to ASCII STL (no extra dependencies).

export_layer(→ None)

Export the active Napari layer using nvitk I/O.

export_selected_layer(→ None)

Export the selected layer, or the topmost layer if none selected.
